stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.sub: The three nuclear powers meet at APEC in Shenzhen; arms control and the Iran war top the agenda.

stories.headline: World Court rules on Rohingya genocide
stories.sub: The ICJ rules in The Gambia's case over the 2017 campaign.

stories.headline: COP31 enters its final 48 hours
stories.sub: Ministers take over the text; 'phase out' and a $120bn fund still open.

stories.headline: GTA VI arrives after a 13-year wait
stories.sub: Unlocks at midnight in each country. New Zealand first; 15.9m pre-orders banked. $79.99 on PS5 and Xbox, no PC yet.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts in the biggest IPO on record
stories.sub: Priced at $83, above its range, the Claude maker raised $81.3bn and is valued near $1.5tn. Thursday's first trades set the real price. Up to a fifth went to retail.

stories.headline: Xi sets out four APEC pillars
stories.sub: China pledges $20m and a research centre in Shenzhen.

stories.headline: Akvan bears down as 200,000 flee the coast
stories.sub: Red alerts in 11 districts; landfall near Puri due Friday.

stories.headline: Left off the agenda, Ukraine watches Shenzhen
stories.sub: The war is off the agenda; Kyiv fears a carve-up.

stories.headline: Flooded Florida braces for still more rain
stories.sub: A foot of rain in Hollywood; 300 rescue calls in a night. Schools shut.

stories.headline: Half a million sit Korea's Suneung
stories.sub: 551,864 sit the exam at 1,312 sites; flights pause, phones blare an alert.

stories.headline: Mélenchon could win, says France's justice minister
stories.sub: The hard-left leader is a plausible president, the minister concedes.

stories.headline: Houthi missile downed over Riyadh
stories.sub: Debris falls on the financial district; officials say the danger has passed.

stories.headline: Cocaine, millions of pills seized in east Libya
stories.sub: Officials display one of the country's biggest drug hauls.
